title: Eggs Obtainable
description: Obtainable spawn eggs - Mob drops and Crafting
body:
- simple pack to make getting spawn eggs possible in survival minecraft.
- only works for vanilla mobs, nothing modded sorry.
- all mobs except the ender dragon and wither have a 5% chance to drop their spawn egg when killed.
- combine a chicken egg and another item related to a mob to craft its spawn egg.
- all recipes are unlocked upon first joining the world.
- may contain bugs.
